'''Enchantress Magilou''' is a [[gnome]] enchanting trainer located at a home to the west of the [[Tower of Magilou]] in [[Northwind]]. Due to her apprentice [[Thronda]]'s mishap in an attempt to summon her own assembly of arcane elementals to help with her chores, the both of them were forced to vacate the tower.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|30|Magilou's Magical Mishap}}</ref>
